rcPromoted.note: Phase 27 must explicitly promote the approved frozen release candidate before a production Android tag is created.

playConsoleAppCreated.note: The com.nvetcare application must exist in the intended Google Play Console account.

playAppSigningEnabled.note: Google Play App Signing must be enabled and the ownership/custody model documented.

uploadCertificatePinned.note: ANDROID_UPLOAD_CERT_SHA256 must be provisioned from the approved upload certificate and verified by the release workflow.

playComplianceContractVerified.note: Phase 13D inventories Android permissions, mobile SDK/data boundaries and the account-deletion lifecycle and fails CI on undeclared drift; external Play Console declarations remain separate evidence.

privacyPolicyPublished.note: The publication source exists in docs/production/NVET_PRIVACY_POLICY_SOURCE.md, but a verified public production HTTPS policy URL, monitored privacy contact, effective date and controller identity are still required.

dataSafetyReviewed.note: The engineering matrix exists in docs/production/GOOGLE_PLAY_DATA_SAFETY.md; the actual Play Console Data safety declaration still requires production-provider and operator review.

accountDeletionAvailable.note: Phase 13D implements the self-service mobile and backend deletion lifecycle, server-side blockers, re-authentication, session revocation, pseudonymized retention and a public deletion-information route contract. Production reachability/provider-side purge remain separately tracked external evidence.

playReviewerAccessConfigured.note: The reviewer runbook exists, but dedicated CLIENT/VET reviewer accounts and non-secret Play Console access instructions must be configured and tested externally.

signedAabVerified.note: A successful Release Android run must produce a signed AAB, SHA-256 checksum, compliance manifest checksum and release metadata from an immutable tag.

internalTrackUploaded.note: The signed candidate must be uploaded to a non-production Play track before production rollout. When verified, observedAt must contain the real ISO-8601 timestamp of the completed internal-track upload so the minimum observation window can be enforced.

physicalDeviceSmokeVerified.note: At least two physical Android devices must complete login, pet, booking, appointment, account-deletion readiness and recovery smoke tests.

android16BehaviorReviewCompleted.note: Android 16/API 36 behavior changes were reviewed against the current mobile architecture; explicit predictive-back and large-screen stabilization decisions are enforced by CI while external physical-device evidence remains separate.
